notes: Libraries made with the NEBNext Small RNA Library Prep Set (adapter ligation kit, manufacturer's protocol, no fragmentation described): assay_class set to other, not small_rna, since no size selection is described. hfq::3xFLAG tag only -> reference. Phase mid_exponential inferred from OD 0.3 in LB, kept for the 20/60 min samples (<= 2 h). Uninfected samples at all times are controls. mixed_organism true for infected samples (phage RNA). Temperature and aeration not stated.
